outcome: Development manifests keep each captured case's immutable source_ref separate from an explicit source_root used to locate bytes, so manifest depth cannot change case resolution and assembled inputs remain hash-bound.
practical_value: Operators can move or nest manifests and runs without manufacturing duplicate directory trees or changing approved case identity.
stopping_condition: A repository-relative source_ref works from two manifest depths through the canonical launcher and composition paths, an absolute source_root does not alter the logical reference, a moved assembly still verifies, and changed imported bytes fail closed.

captured_cases.expected_outcome: The canonical launcher and composer resolve unchanged source_ref bytes from an explicit source_root at any manifest depth.
Assembly verification accepts a moved intact package and rejects any changed imported case bytes without changing logical case identity.
